title: Self-Emergence Agent Architecture:Behavior-Inertia HMM, Reflexive Metacognition,and Social-Contrastive Self-Modeling
abstract: arXiv:2609.17331v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents exhibit strong language-generation and problem-solving capabilities, yet suffer from three structural limitations: personality drift, non-evolutionary reflection, and the absence of a self-other boundary. Existing generative-agent simulations rely on static memory and fixed prompts, maintaining neither behavioral inertia nor endogenous self-evolution. We propose the Self-Emergence Agent Architecture (SEAA), which integrates three components: (i) a Hidden Markov Model (HMM) that encodes long-term behavioral and cognitive inertia as an editable state-transition matrix; (ii) a Reflexion-style verbal metacognition loop whose output updates the HMM parameters themselves, rather than merely being stored as text; and (iii) a multi-agent social environment in which initially identical agents continuously compare their behavior with others'. The three components form a closed loop: social action $\to$ feedback $\

translated_title: 自涌现智能体架构：行为惯性隐马尔可夫模型、反思性元认知与社会对比自我建模
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）智能体展现出强大的语言生成与问题解决能力，但仍存在三个结构性局限：人格漂移、非演化性反思以及自我-他人边界的缺失。现有的生成式智能体模拟依赖静态记忆和固定提示词，既无法维持行为惯性，也无法实现内生自我演化。我们提出了自涌现智能体架构（SEAA），该架构集成了三个组件：（i）一个隐马尔可夫模型（HMM），将长期行为与认知惯性编码为可编辑的状态转移矩阵；（ii）一个反思式（Reflexion风格）的言语元认知循环，其输出会直接更新HMM参数本身，而不仅仅是作为文本存储；（iii）一个多智能体社会环境，其中初始完全相同的智能体持续地将自身行为与他人进行对比。这三个组件构成一个闭环：社会行动 → 反馈 →（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出自涌现智能体架构（SEAA），通过行为惯性HMM、反思性元认知循环与多智能体社会对比三者构成的闭环，克服LLM智能体的人格漂移问题并实现内生自我演化。
en_tdlr: Proposes the Self-Emergence Agent Architecture (SEAA), which forms a closed loop among a behavior-inertia HMM, reflexive verbal metacognition, and multi-agent social-contrastive self-modeling to overcome personality drift and enable endogenous self-evolution in LLM agents.
